title: LintProfile: lints() and lint_runner() duplicate lint lists
description:
In pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs, both BasicTlsProfile and BasicSmimeProfile have LintProfile impls where lints() (backed by a static OnceLock) and lint_runner() construct identical lint lists independently (lines 260-284 and 386-409). If a developer adds a lint to one but not the other, the two views silently diverge.

What goes wrong: lints() returns the static-cached list for read-only inspection; lint_runner() builds a fresh LintRunner with its own list. If these drift, check_shape (which uses lint_runner) runs a different set of checks than code inspecting lints().

Locations:
- pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs, BasicTlsProfile LintProfile impl (lines ~260-284)
- pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs, BasicSmimeProfile LintProfile impl (lines ~386-409)

Recommendation: Factor the lint-list construction into a single function and have both lints() and lint_runner() call it.
